verdict.rationale: dlt is primarily an ELT/pipeline library, but its dltHub AI Harness includes an agent skill that reads chart specs and Ibis/Altair code from an analysis plan and assembles/launches a Marimo notebook, which is a thin form of AI-assisted data insight generation. There is no dedicated feature that proactively analyzes loaded data and surfaces AI-generated insights/suggestions beyond this one skill mention. Missing for 10: a documented insight/recommendation engine analyzing pipeline data, independent/hands-on evidence the marimo/chart skill actually produces meaningful insights, and broader coverage of this capability beyond a single skill description.
